Finisar 1000BASE-T Copper SFP Module, RJ-45, 100m Reach, Hot-Pluggable

The Finisar 1000BASE-T SFP transceiver is a copper SFP module that provides Gigabit Ethernet connectivity over standard Category 5 unshielded twisted pair (UTP) cables for distances up to 100 meters.

Key Specifications

  • Model: FCLF-8520-3-ER
  • Data Rate: 1.25 Gbps (1000 Mbps)
  • Transmission Distance: Up to 100 meters (328 feet)
  • Connector: RJ-45
  • Cable Type: Cat 5 , Cat 6 UTP
  • Power Supply Voltage: 3.3V
  • Power Consumption: ~1.05W typical
  • Operating Temperature: -40°C to +85°C (Industrial Temp Range)

Features

  • Hot-pluggable SFP footprint
  • Fully metallic housing for low EMI
  • Auto-negotiates between 10/100/1000 Mbps
  • Supports full-duplex operation
  • Built-in PHY for link diagnostics and configuration via I2C
  • LED indicators for status monitoring (host dependent)

Applications

  • Switches and routers with SFP ports
  • Gigabit Ethernet networking over existing copper infrastructure
  • Data center, campus, and enterprise LAN deployments
